items.title: 52220_Woody Herman oral history interview
items.q: Alan Vizzutti, who I think is one of the outstanding sheer legitimate trumpet players that I've ever heard in my entire life.

ctx.x: It's some kind of a -- it's almost like a charm, with that particular school, as far as brass players are concerned. It holds true of some of the trumpet players I had go through the band from there. I'll pick one at random. Alan Vizzutti, who I think is one of the outstanding sheer legitimate trumpet players that I've ever heard in my entire life.
And both of them, that is, Jim and Al, are with Chick Corea now.
